default.description: Default capability set for the MeedyaDL application. Grants permissions for file system access, native dialogs, shell execution, OS detection, opening/revealing files and folders, and process management. `shell:allow-open` is for web addresses only (its address pattern refuses anything that is not mailto:/tel:/http(s):, so it can never be used to open a file on disk); opening or revealing a file/folder goes through the separate `opener:*` permissions below instead, scoped just to that.
